scenarios.question_zh: 结账响应将 allowed_combinations 收窄为礼品卡 immediate + 1 张卡时是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Does per-checkout allowed_combinations narrowing to immediate gift_card + 1 card pass?
scenarios.detail: UCP PR #987 per-checkout split payment combinations and schedule_type constraints verified

scenarios.question_zh: 结账响应 allowed_combinations 超出商户 Profile 上界时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Are per-checkout allowed_combinations that widen the business profile rejected?
scenarios.detail: Per-checkout allowed_combinations must only narrow the business profile's allowed_combinations

scenarios.domain: UCP #987 Deferred Term Requires Non-Immediate Group
scenarios.question_zh: 含远期账期的结账若仅包含 immediate 组且无远期可扣款工具时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Are deferred terms without at least one mandatory non-immediate group rejected?
scenarios.detail: Deferred payment terms require at least one mandatory non-immediate instrument group in every combination

scenarios.domain: UCP #987 Deposit Now ($25 GC) + Balance Later ($75 Card)
scenarios.question_zh: $25 礼品卡支付当期押金、信用卡承担 $75 入住尾款并报告全周期贡献时是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Does $25 immediate gift card deposit + $75 deferred card balance allocation pass?
scenarios.detail: UCP PR #987 split-payment contributions allocated across immediate and deferred schedules

scenarios.question_zh: immediate 组的礼品卡指定金额（$50）超过当期应付押金（$25）时是否返回 payment_failed？
scenarios.question_en: Is an immediate-group gift card specifying $50 when only $25 is due at completion rejected?
scenarios.detail: Immediate-group instrument 'pi_gc_1' amount (5000) exceeds remaining due at completion (2500)

scenarios.domain: UCP #987 Voided Instrument Outbound Amount Leak
scenarios.question_zh: 已作废或未尝试扣款的支付工具在结账响应中仍携带 amount 字段时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Are voided or unattempted instruments that still include an outbound amount rejected?
scenarios.detail: Voided or unattempted instrument 'pi_voided' must omit outbound amount

scenarios.domain: ACP #316 (`8802ebe`) §7.4a Req 5 RFC 3161 Ledger Time Anchor
scenarios.question_zh: 具备完整序列、匹配摘要、RFC 3161 时间戳证明与重算位置的账本证据包是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Does a ledger evidence pack with verified RFC 3161 time anchor and recompute location pass?
scenarios.detail: ACP ATDRP §7.4a Requirement 5 ledger time anchor and post-anchor boundary verified

scenarios.domain: ACP #316 (`8802ebe`) Post-Anchor Unanchored Records Ground Block
scenarios.question_zh: 最后一次时间锚定之后写入的 unanchored 记录作为时间类争议唯一依据时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Are post-anchor unanchored records rejected as the sole basis for a time-based dispute ground?
scenarios.detail: Records written after the last time anchor are unanchored and MUST NOT be the sole basis for a time-based ground

scenarios.domain: ACP #316 (`8802ebe`) Anchor Existence vs. Truth Conflation Block
scenarios.question_zh: 将时间锚定（仅证明集合在锚定时刻前存在）误当作记录内容真实性证明时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Is conflating a time anchor's existence attestation with truth of record contents blocked?
scenarios.detail: Time anchor attests only that the ledger set existed by anchor_time, not that a record in it is true

scenarios.question_zh: 多笔原子交易组具备一致创世网络、非空规范 group_digest、单笔代付且无抽干字段时是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Does a multi-tx sponsored group with canonical group_digest, single fee-payer & no drain fields pass?
scenarios.detail: x402 §10.3 pre-signing group sponsorship invariants verified prior to private-key signing

scenarios.domain: x402 #3910 §10.3 Unbound null==null Group Digest Block
scenarios.question_zh: 多笔交易组中 group_digest 为空（企图诱导 Facilitator 单独签名未绑定交易）时是否签名前阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Are multi-tx groups with null/missing group_digest blocked prior to facilitator private-key signing?
scenarios.detail: Transaction 0 missing or mismatched canonical group_digest

scenarios.domain: x402 #3898 Payment Creation Hook Correlation & Cleanup
scenarios.question_zh: createPaymentPayload 共享单次调用上下文且 before 钩子中止时执行清理并不启动签名是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Does correlated hook context with before-abort cleanup and zero payload creation pass?
scenarios.detail: x402 PR #3898 payment creation hook correlation and before-abort cleanup invariants verified

scenarios.domain: x402 #3898 Recovery Override on Before-Hook Abort Block
scenarios.question_zh: before 钩子拒绝后若 failure 钩子的 recovery 返回值企图强行覆盖拒绝并继续创建载荷时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Is overriding a before-hook rejection via a failure-hook recovery return blocked?
scenarios.detail: Failure hook recovery results cannot override a before-hook rejection

scenarios.domain: x402 #3892 SVM Failed Local Charge Reservation Release
scenarios.question_zh: SVM 本地批量扣款在 beforeSettle 失败时是否释放预留额度并保留兄弟预留与已消费 ID？
scenarios.question_en: Does a failed SVM local batch charge release its reservation while preserving sibling state?
scenarios.detail: x402 PR #3892 SVM failed local charge reservation cleanup verified

scenarios.domain: x402 #3892 SVM Leaked Reservation Blocking Close
scenarios.question_zh: SVM 本地扣款失败后未释放 4000 单位预留额度（导致通道合作关闭被死锁）时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Is leaking a 4,000-unit SVM batch reservation after a failed local charge blocked?
scenarios.detail: Failed SVM local batch charge must release its reserved capacity so cooperative close is not blocked

scenarios.domain: x402 #3899/#3901/#3904 Header Overflow, Raw Text & Stellar 16.4.1
scenarios.question_zh: 识别 UND_ERR_HEADERS_OVERFLOW 保留 cause 且不自动重试、text/plain 原样输出及 stellar-sdk>=16.4.1 是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Do header overflow cause preservation, raw text/plain 402 body & stellar-sdk>=16.4.1 pass?
scenarios.detail: x402 PR #3899/#3901/#3902/#3904 HTTP header overflow diagnostics, text/plain body & Stellar SDK floor verified
